about: Text → the pieces a knowledge document is cut into for search: about `size` characters (raised to 200 when smaller), cut just after a paragraph break, else a line break, else a sentence's ". ", found in the window's last third, with `overlap` characters (at most half the size) repeated; CRLF read as LF; pieces under 40 characters dropped.

cases.text:

Second paragraph follows here and keeps going for a while so that a second piece is needed, and a third sentence makes sure of it.

cases.text: Sentences only. Each one ends with a full stop. There is no line break at all in this text. So the cut must fall after a sentence. Which one depends on the window. The window is two hundred characters wide. A cut is looked for only in its last third. That keeps every piece close to the size asked for.
